title: Medical Specialty Prediction from Bangla Patient Narratives: A Comparative Study of ML, DL, Transformers, and LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.29151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Timely access to appropriate medical specialists remains a bottleneck in Bangladesh's healthcare system, as patients describe symptoms in informal Bangla rather than clinical terms, leading to ineffective referrals. This paper compares four model families for predicting medical specialties from Bangla patient narratives: six machine learning (ML) models using hybrid TF-IDF features, four deep learning (DL) models using Word2Vec embeddings trained on the corpus, four fine-tuned transformers, and five large language models (LLMs) evaluated zero-shot. From a corpus of 3798 patient records covering 20 specialties, we retained the five with the most records (Medicine, Gynecology, Dermatology, Pediatrics, Gastroenterology) and split the resulting 2730 records 80:20 into training and test sets shared by all families. translated_title: 基于孟加拉语患者叙述的医学专科预测：机器学习、深度学习、Transformer与大语言模型的比较研究
translated_abstract: 及时获得合适的医疗专科服务仍是孟加拉国医疗体系的瓶颈，因为患者通常用非正式的孟加拉语而非临床术语来描述症状，导致转诊效率低下。本文比较了四类模型在从孟加拉语患者叙述中预测医学专科方面的表现：使用混合TF-IDF特征的六种机器学习（ML）模型、使用基于语料库训练的Word2Vec词向量的四种深度学习（DL）模型、四种微调的Transformer模型，以及五种以零样本（zero-shot）方式评估的大语言模型（LLM）。语料库包含覆盖20个专科的3798条患者记录，我们保留了记录数最多的五个专科（内科、妇科、皮肤科、儿科、胃肠科），并将由此得到的2730条记录按80:20划分为所有模型家族共用的训练集和测试集。表现最佳的Transformer模型是XLM-RoBERTa（准确率86.26%，宏平均F1为86.21%），最佳的机器学习模型是SVM（84.98%，84.92%），最佳的深度学习模型……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究针对孟加拉语非正式患者叙述构建了医学专科预测任务，并系统比较了机器学习、深度学习、Transformer和大语言模型四类方法的表现，其中微调的XLM-RoBERTa以86.26%的准确率取得最佳效果。
en_tdlr: This study introduces medical specialty prediction from informal Bangla patient narratives and systematically compares ML, DL, transformer, and LLM approaches, with fine-tuned XLM-RoBERTa achieving the best performance at 86.26% accuracy.
